description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Keysight Technologies hires a software engineer for its High Frequency Technology Center software development group. The role develops and maintains software used across Keysight’s Santa Rosa wafer fab, test floor, and assembly lines, including applications, data pipelines, and wafer test-station software.
Software Engineer developing and maintaining fab-wide C#/.NET applications, shared libraries, data pipelines, and wafer test station software

Responsibilities:
• Fix bugs and add features in software used every day across the fab: applications, shared libraries, data pipelines, and the software on our wafer test stations
• Help build software for new areas of the fab
• Work with the engineers, operators and technicians who use our software, and build what they need
• Help support production: investigate errors from the floor and from Sentry, with a senior developer
• Write tests for existing code, and learn to change production code safely

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related field, completed between May 2026 and June 2027, or a recent graduate with under 2 years of professional experience
• Solid object-oriented programming in C#, Java or C++, shown through internships, projects, research or open-source work
• At least one substantial program you built or significantly changed that you can walk through in detail
• Basic SQL: joins, grouping and filtering
• Comfortable with a debugger and with Git
• Clear written and spoken communication
• Candidates must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or protected individual, having authorization from the U.S. government for export-controlled items under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)

Preferred:
• A software internship or co-op
• C#/.NET experience
• Software that works with data from real systems: files, sensors, equipment or databases
• Exposure to manufacturing or semiconductors
• Desktop (WPF) or web (ASP.NET) development
